text:
alex kim: Quick heads-up — partners asked for a consolidated window for H200/B200 pre-announcement + marketplace SKU gating. Can we lock dates so SIs can book dryruns?
sara li: Yes, we need a hard embargo window and a separate SI dryrun week. EU legal also asked for 72h review before any partner comms.
raj patel: @sara noted. What are constraints from capacity side? we need a canary capacity plan if press goes out. :eyes:
emily j: Capacity wise, we can reserve a small dedicated pool for canary traffic. Suggesting 100 concurrent slots across h200/b200 for the week of cutover.
daniela rodriguez: Also need SKU tags in marketplace so SIs can validate images. I'll own SKU mapping.
alex kim: Awesome. Draft timeline proposal below — open to edits.
```
- Week A (prep): finalize compatibility matrix + SI dryrun invites
- Week B (dryruns): SI full-stack tests (EU/NA regions) + bug triage
- Mid-week B: embargo lift candidate for internal-only docs
- Week C (announce window): 48-72h embargo notification to press, marketplace listing goes live in phased regions
- Week D: canary customers + rollback/fallback monitoring for 72h
```
sara li: Marking EU legal review slot on Mon of Week A. Also — can we promise staggered region rollout? APAC needs extra firmware cert time.
raj patel: We should include a fallback model routing policy in case H200 nodes hit thermal or firmware regressions — automatic fallback to B200/gaudi variants if perf drops >15%.
emily j: I'll add a runtime routing policy to the rollout config. Need the exact model variant labels from model-onboard.
daniela rodriguez: SKU mapping draft: `H200-v1-dedicated`, `B200-v1-dedicated`, `H200-v1-marketplace`, `B200-v1-marketplace`. Will push to the shared sheet tonight.
alex kim: Great. Action items: @daniela push SKU draft, @emily add routing policy, @raj confirm canary capacity numbers with infra, @sara coordinate legal embargo. Owners check off by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:
partners-bot: Calendar event created: "H200/B200 partners dryrun" on 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, legal-eu
sara li: Got the invite, thanks. One more ask from partners: they want a short runbook for SI troubleshooting (network, image tags, kernel). Can someone draft a 1-pager?
emily j: I'll draft the runbook templates. Will include sample `docker run` and `kv-cache` tuning hints.
raj patel: I'll confirm the dedicated pool sizing tonight and post numbers.
daniela rodriguez: SKU sheet link: https://docs.internal/redwood/sku-mapping (private) — adding notes for firmware windows.
alex kim: Solid. If no objections, we'll treat this as our canonical timeline and share with vendor PMs tomorrow morning. :rocket:
sara li: No objections from me. Go ahead.
emily j: +1
raj patel: +1
daniela rodriguez: +1
partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 3 days before Week A start.
